shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat package-lock.json | head -30; git log --stat | head -40; node --version; npm --version

rm -rf data && (PORT=3456 node server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 0.7 && cat /tmp/server.log
LOC=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' -d 'title=The+Left+Hand+of+Darkness&author=Ursula+K.+Le+Guin&notes=Winter+on+Gethen.' http://localhost:3456/books)
echo "redirected to: $LOC"
curl -s -d 'title=Piranesi&author=Susanna+Clarke' http://localhost:3456/books -o /dev/null
curl -s -X POST "$LOC/finish" -o /dev/null
echo "--- detail page ---"; curl -s "$LOC" | grep -E '<h1>|class="author"|class="meta"|class="notes"|Link to this'
echo "--- home page ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -E '<h2>|<li>'
echo "--- stored file ---"; cat data/books.json
pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 0.3
echo "--- after restart ---"; (PORT=3456 node server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 0.7 && curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -E '<li>'; pkill -f "node server.js"
PORT=3456 node server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 & PID=$!; sleep 0.7; curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -E '<li>'; kill $PID; rm -rf /workspace/data
